repairs.quote: When used on an ally, Lulu grants (25% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed and 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds. When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds. Polymorphed targets are Silenced, Disarmed, and Slowed by 60.
